{{Short description|Taiwanese plasma physicist (born 1942)}}
'''Chu Kwo-ray''' ({{zh|t=朱國瑞}}; born 10 October 1942) is a Taiwanese plasma physicist.<ref>{{cite news |title=Congratulations to Academicians Chen-Shui Tsai and Kwo-Ray Chu on Being Selected 2nd NTU's Outstanding Alumni in Academic Category |url=https://newsletter.sinica.edu.tw/reviews/en/news/read_newsbd42.html |access-date=22 September 2023 |publisher=Academia Sinica |date=2007 |quote=Academician Kwo-Ray Chu is a Professor at Department of Physics, National Tsing Hua University. He specializes in plasma physics and, in particular, the generation of coherent electromagnetic waves via the electron cyclotron maser (ECM) interaction.}}</ref>

== Life and career ==
Chu was born on 10 October 1942.<ref name="nstc">{{cite news |title=Academician Kwo Ray Chu's Personal Profiles |url=https://web.nstc.gov.tw/SciencePrize/2021/4910936615.html |access-date=22 September 2023 |publisher=[[National Science and Technology Council (Taiwan)|National Science and Technology Council]]}}</ref> He pursued a Bachelor of Science degree from [[National Taiwan University]], graduating in 1965. He then obtained a master's of science in the same subject at the [[University of Massachusetts]] in 1968. He completed a doctorate in applied physics at [[Cornell University]] in 1973.<ref name="nstc"/><ref name="as">{{cite news |title=Kwo Ray Chu |url=https://academicians.sinica.edu.tw/index.php?r=academician-n%2Fshow&id=226&_lang=en |access-date=22 September 2023 |publisher=Academia Sinica}}</ref>

Chu subsequently worked for the [[Leidos|Science Applications International Corporation]] until 1978, when he joined the [[United States Naval Research Laboratory]].<ref name="nthup"/><ref name="ntup"/> He returned to Taiwan in September 1983 to accept a professorship within the physics department at [[National Tsing Hua University]].<ref name="nstc"/><ref name="nthup">{{cite news |title=Professor Chu, Kwo-Ray |url=http://www.phys.nthu.edu.tw/e_teacher/krchu.html |access-date=22 September 2023}}</ref> In 2010, Kuo became a distinguished chair professor of the [[National Taiwan University]] Department of Physics.<ref name="ntup">{{cite news |title=Faculty (by Directory) Kwo-Ray Chu |url=https://www.phys.ntu.edu.tw/enphysics/krchu.html |access-date=22 September 2023 |publisher=National Taiwan University, Department of Physics}}</ref>

Chu's honors and awards include election as fellow of the [[American Physical Society]] in 1983,<ref name="ntup"/><ref name="apsfellowlist">{{cite news |title=APS fellow archive |url=https://aps.org/programs/honors/fellowships/archive-all.cfm?initial=C&year=&unit_id=&institution= |access-date=22 September 2023 |publisher=American Physical Society}}</ref> and [[IEEE]] in 1997,<ref name="as"/><ref name="ntup"/> membership within [[Academia Sinica]] in 2002,<ref name="as"/> and receiving a {{ill|Presidential Science Prize|zh|總統科學獎}} in 2003.<ref name="nstc"/><ref name="nthup"/><ref name="ntup"/>
